content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. AGC68-ACAD0PGC(MISC)/26/2026 - PGS gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ANGRAU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: a) Ph.D. in MBA (Agribusiness Management) (or) b) Master's degree in MBA (Agribusiness Management) with Bachelors Degree of 4/5 years having first division or equivalent overall grade point; at least 3 years of respective teaching/research experience; one research paper in SCI/NAAS rated >=4.0 journals; NET qualification in the relevant subject mandatory Experience: At least 3 years of respective teaching/research experience as evidenced from Fellowship/ Associateship/ Training/ Other engagements Age limit: Maximum 40 years for Men / 45 years for Women Age relaxation: Women Upper age limit 45 years Other conditions: Engaged purely on temporary and terminated contractual basis. Selected candidates will be required to undergo medical examination at their own expenses. No T.A. & D.A. will be given to the candidates appearing for interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: 11 months from date of joining or filling of regular post, whichever is earlier Purely temporary contractual engagement; no claim to any regular appointment in the university or any government organization No right to further continuation of contractual service Engagement can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason Engaged person may leave by giving one month notice, otherwise must pay one-month salary

content_sections.heading: How Will ANGRAU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Decision of the selection committee is final and binding in all respects

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: All original certificates One set of bio-data Xerox copies of educational qualifications Xerox copies of other certificates, if any Social Status certificate Passport size photo

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ANGRAU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Attend the walk-in interview on 03-12-2026 at 11.00 AM at Advanced Post Graduate Centre, Lam, Guntur. Bring all original certificates. Submit one set of bio-data with Xerox copies of educational qualifications, other certificates if any, Social Status and a passport size photo at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must undergo medical examination at their own expense before appointment Concealing facts or canvassing in any form leads to disqualification or termination The Associate Dean has the right to cancel or postpone the interviews due to unavoidable circumstances HRA is paid at existing State Government rates and may change as per Government orders
